div.span: - A find on mongo1 sees the write that was just acknowledged, because the primary holds the authoritative copy.

div.b: Reading a secondary spreads the load

div.span: - With setReadPref('secondary') the query runs on mongo2. The answer can be a moment behind the primary, which is the price of the extra read capacity.
